scope: Read-only review of all seven original package criteria against current modules, assignments, book/index routes and retained actual evidence. One acceptance review receipt; no new status framework.
reviewer_relationship: Reviewer authored CS33607; its independent acceptance is separately recorded in systems/operations-peer-review.json and data/native-audit-peer-review.json. Other packages inspected read-only.
conclusion: No missing original package criterion found. Negative outcomes meet the declared scientific checks without claiming capability or performance improvement.

packages.title: Assignment structure and assessment
review_findings: Six Assignment A-F briefs name inputs, reused mechanisms/modules via canonical companions, inspectable deliverables, independent checks and failed-case interpretation; common correctness/comparison/interpretation/reproduction rubric distinguishes reference readiness from learner submission.

All fifteen chapters link their assignment milestone; fifteen matching solution guides and sixteen lab guides integrate the route. Original chapter/day registry rows, numbered exercises and complete original notebook files are preserved.

Existing verifier, run identities and experiment contracts are reused. Posttraining is a consumer with a module CLI, not a second orchestration framework. No duplicate package status ledger was introduced.
packages.limits: Readiness is not learner completion or publication authority.

packages.title: Tokenizer contracts and comparable likelihood
review_findings: Adapter wraps existing ByteBPE; original merges/IDs, unseen UTF-8 round-trip, special-marker isolation, overlapping admission, normalization/segmentation, malformed decoding and serialized identity have original independent edge checks.

Record framing and chunks-of-one-record are explicit. Chunk equivalence buffers the declared record with a max-record guard; arbitrary independent chunk encoding is exposed as incorrect. Buffer memory is disclosed.

Bits per byte aggregates summed scored NLL over corresponding UTF-8 bytes. EOS/context/mask/normalization conventions are part of the identity; incompatible contracts are refused. Independent weighted-rate checks avoid averaging per-record rates.
packages.limits: New functionality is routed via registered companions and original Day2/Day3 indexes; original learner notebook bytes remain unchanged. Whole-record buffering is not bounded-memory streaming BPE.

packages.title: Corpus curation and exposure
review_findings: Original bounded HTML/text fixture includes useful short/code/multilingual/navigation/altered-copy/contact slices. HTMLParser retains raw, matching and training representations and reason-coded identity/count reconciliation, including useful removals.

Seeded MinHash/LSH candidates are verified by exact Jaccard against all-pairs oracle. Original tests cover exact/near duplicates, false candidates, empty text and transitive components. Default retrieval recall/precision are 1/1; the one-band failure retains recall 1/3, and the false-candidate control precision is 0. Split audit reports no source/group crossings.

All three declared seeds run raw/exact/curated arms for 24 updates, with matched tokenizer/initialization/context/visibility/loss/schedule and 32 valid targets per update: 768 per arm. Runtime, repetitions, omitted tails, fixed generations and slice NLL are retained.

Curated held-out NLL exceeds exact in all three seeds; all fixed greedy outputs reach cap32 without natural EOS. Independent default-compatibility receipt reproduces original TrainingSession contract, four update records and parameter tensors exactly.
Retention waterfall, similarity map, duplicate graph and exposure/learning curves have regenerating references. Matching/rule scores do not become calibrated quality estimates.
packages.limits: Eleven authored records and nine short fits do not validate web-scale curation or coherent English learning.

packages.title: Hardware performance and checkpointing
review_findings: Matmul, attention, prefill and cached-token ledgers reconcile shape/FLOP/byte units and state counted operations, exclusions and reuse assumptions. Traffic is modeled, not measured memory-controller traffic.

Existing StoriesDecoder checkpointing uses identical FP64 weights/data, MHA and disabled Q/K normalization; predeclared loss/gradient absolute tolerance is 1e-12 in independent checks. Actual differences are zero and both checkpointed blocks recompute. Saved storage is distinct from peak and speedup.

Hypothetical FP64 roofline and actual CPU timing are separate. GB10 receipts retain actual device/precision/backend, warmup, synchronization, repetitions, spread and allocator semantics. No suitable precision peak means estimated matmul FLOP/s without utilization; no H100/B200 substitution or CPU point on GPU roofline.

The actual GPU supplement times preallocated matmul, preallocated decoder forward, and an input-generation/transfer/forward pipeline, each with host-synchronized intervals and CUDA-event stream spans; a separate profiler trace observes one decoder forward. Prefill/cached-token work belongs to modeled phase ledgers, and checkpoint/backward recomputation belongs to the CPU reference; no GPU cached-decode, backward or optimizer timing is claimed. Event spans may include host-dispatch idle time and are not individual-kernel durations. Unsynchronized submission/completion is a labeled illustrative failure, not an actual GPU benchmark.
packages.limits: No hardware-counter traffic, compatible-peak utilization, fused-kernel identity proof or checkpoint speedup claim.

packages.title: IO-aware attention
review_findings: Independent online attention rescales previous numerator/normalizer when the maximum changes. SDPA oracles check output/gradients across FP64/FP32, tiles, causal/padding boundaries, ragged lengths and query offsets; numerical gradcheck is included.
Fully masked rows are defined as zero output, negative-infinite LSE and zero masked gradient. Large logits and omitted old-state rescaling expose broken variants.

Tile flow and intermediate-size plots have adjacent runnable references. Forward modeled workspace, saved backing storage and device/process peak are separate; ordinary autograd does not establish backward-memory savings or FlashAttention performance.
packages.limits: Ordinary autograd may retain intermediates; Triton backward/distributed execution remain optional P2.

packages.title: Scaling estimates and prediction
review_findings: Authored zero-noise surface recovers parameter exponent 0.5 and excess-loss exponent -0.25 within declared tolerance 1e-12. Larger-budget prediction is frozen before reveal; all fifteen target rows and grid error are retained.

Independent tests refuse insufficient budgets, boundary minima, invalid logarithms and mixed architecture/data/mode contracts. Bootstrap preserves failures. New six-condition sensitivity freezes all predictions before revealing the target and varies fit range, seed/data points, omitted center and assumed floor; no favorable-condition selection.

Optional empirical matrix retains all 24 runs: three sizes, three calibration budgets, one held-out budget and two seeds. Boundary preference at the smallest budget yields a refusal frozen before six held-out runs. All train/dev/test losses, unique 256-target capacity, repeats, target/actual 6ND, 18,880 presented targets and runtime remain distinct.
No empirical optimum/exponent or large-model forecast is inferred from the refusal. TinyStories time-series checkpoints are not pooled into a scaling fit.
packages.limits: Sensitivity is explicitly simulated; measured matrix is a frozen refusal rather than an empirical law.

packages.title: Integrated post-training and reward signal
review_findings: One symbolic vocabulary/model/serialization/ownership/stop/support identity carries actual CPU initialized parents into coverage/repetition SFT, then coverage-SFT-parent accepted-response SFT, GRPO-std and center-only siblings. Weight hashes, frozen-reference checks and first shared sample pool establish actual ancestry; historical native roots remain separate.

Balanced parity has multiple distinct sources per answer class/split, paired forms on common held-out sources and independent withheld-family diagnostic. Seeds 33671/33672/33673 and constant/majority 0.5 controls are retained. Both SFT arms get 768 targets. Coverage beats repetition, but final reward arms remain below the constant control.

Every declared CPU seed has genuinely sampled train/development successes and failures, mixed groups and independent task-reward gradient. Training/development difficulty eligibility, changed populations, discarded candidates/groups and physical generation/scoring costs are recorded.

Task/KL/combined gradients, task-advantage norms, completion, entropy and KL are separate. Full-vocabulary CE differs explicitly from grammar-conditioned sampling/scoring. Existing normalization kernels and finite joint group enumeration preserve normalizer correlation, conditional estimator and collection cost.

All 192 historical strict rewards replay zero unchanged; separately named richer diagnostic finds one complete success and retains full text, statuses and reason codes. Adversarial checker references independently check correctness, format, stop/truncation and unsupported parsing.

Frozen optional native audit collects all 48 prescribed responses with pinned local BF16 model and resource caps: strict reward zero, all richer UNSUPPORTED, zero mixed groups and zero task-head gradient in train/development. Failed signal gate is the result. Same-parent native SFT/RL remains optional/unexecuted; no extended campaign or capability improvement is claimed.
packages.limits: CPU symbolic signal is conditional-support mechanism evidence. Native absence of signal is a valid diagnostic; native SFT/RL is optional/unexecuted, not a missing completion prerequisite.
